title: The Frog (Halloween)
wikitext:
{{Item infobox | name = The Frog [Halloween] | rarity = 4 | image = [[Image:The Frog (Halloween).png]] | type = [[Miniature]] | campaign= [[Core]] | render = [[File:The Frog Halloween.jpg|150px]] }} [[The Frog (Halloween)|The Frog [Halloween]]] is a [[miniature]] version of [[The Frog]] wearing a witch hat. It is completely unique and [[Gaile Gray]] is the only person to own one. It was a gift to her from the developers along with the [[The Frog (miniature)|regular version]] upon her leaving her role as [[ArenaNet]] Community Relations Manager, a position she held for more than five years. == Notes == * This miniature was first revealed during [[Halloween 2008]]. * The other holiday version of the Frog is the [[The Frog (Wintersday)|Wintersday Frog]]. == Trivia ==
